products.title: T Squared T-Zero
products.body_html:
Zero torque changes how the putter behaves in your hands. Instead of twisting open and shut through the stroke, the T-Zero face stays square from takeaway to impact. Your ball starts on your line and holds it.

The result is simple. The putts you should make start dropping.

  • Zero torque design, the face stays square through impact
  • two piece aluminum head
  • 4 degree loft, 70 degree lie
  • Milled and built under one roof in Orchard Park, New York

COMES WITH HEAD COVER AND T SQUARED STANDARD BLACK GRIP

products.title: T Squared Gift Card
products.body_html: A T Squared gift card lets the player in your life walk into our configurator and build the putter they actually want. Right handed or left. Toe hang or face balanced. Custom or stock. No guessing. No returning the wrong build

products.title: T Squared Standard Blade/Mid-Mallet Headcover
products.body_html: Designed to fit standard blade and mid-mallet putters, the T Squared Standard Blade/Mid-Mallet Headcover combines a soft, microfiber-lined interior with a durable exterior shell and a secure magnetic closure for quick on-and-off access between holes. The all-over T-block pattern keeps it unmistakably T Squared in your bag and on the green, while reinforced stitching ensures it holds up round after round.

products.title: T Squared Standard Mallet Headcover
products.body_html: Built to fit any standard-size mallet putter, the T Squared Standard Mallet Headcover pairs a soft, microfiber-lined interior with a durable exterior shell and a secure magnetic closure for quick on-and-off access between holes. The all-over T-block pattern and centered T SQUARED PUTTERS badge make it instantly recognizable in your bag and on the green, while reinforced stitching ensures it holds up round after round.

products.title: TS-905 Mid-Mallet Custom
products.body_html:
The TS-905 is a distinctive half-moon-shaped mid-mallet that boasts soft, subtle sloping lines and a curved sole, meticulously designed to optimize performance on the green. Its unique curvature and perimeter weighting are strategically engineered to maximize the Moment of Inertia (MOI), providing exceptional stability and forgiveness in every putt.

Head weight with components: 350 grams

products.body_html:
A square mid-mallet with soft subtle sloping lines and the curved sole is perimeter weighted optimizing MOI. The top flange line squares the precision milled diamond pattern face to provide a soft but firm feel and classic sound at impact.

products.body_html:
An update on the classic blade, featuring soft subtle sloping flange lines. The larger body moves the weight to the perimeter creating a perfectly balanced putter, thus keeping the head square at impact. The unique alignment T allows for perfect address, while the diamond pattern face provides a classic feel and sound at impact.

The diamond pattern on the face provides a classic feel and sound that we all grew up with.

products.title: TS-1106+ Mallet (Face Balanced Only) Custom
products.body_html:
Introducing our latest putter model, affectionately known as "The CAT." Its signature feature is the revolutionary Alignment T aluminum inlay. This state-of-the-art design, combined with the elongated, perimeter-weighted structure, facilitates a pendulum-like stroke, ensuring a seamless and enhanced putter flow. The Alignment T keeps the putter face perfectly square, and the aircraft aluminum face with Teflon technology delivers a remarkably soft feel at impact. Discover the perfect fusion of innovation and precision, with the all NEW Ts-1106+ 

Head weight with components: 385 grams.

products.title: TS-1104 Mallet Custom
products.body_html:
This mallet addition to our putter line up, known as the BIG PAPA, is the most versatile putter you will find. We have designed it to deliver the best of both worlds, with the increased toe flow of a blade and more forgiving MOI of a mallet.

 Head weight with components: 360 grams.

products.title: TS-1029 Mallet Custom
products.body_html:
Engineered for ultimate forgiveness, the TS-1029 is built from a full aluminum body that delivers exceptional stability and feel across the face. This high-MOI design is ideal for golfers seeking confidence on every stroke — even when contact isn’t perfect. The TS-1029 features clean alignment geometry and a balanced profile that suits a wide range of putting strokes. Milled to exacting standards and finished in classic Tsquared style, it’s a modern answer for players who demand consistency and performance in every round.

The truth is that most golfers don’t need a boutique or heavily engineered shaft to roll the ball well. What they need is a shaft that feels stable in their hands and supports their natural stroke, paired with a length that fits their stance and posture.

products.title: TS-1029 Mallet
products.body_html: Engineered for ultimate forgiveness, the TS-1029 is built from a full aerospace grade aluminum body that delivers exceptional stability and feel across the face. This high MOI design inspires confidence on every stroke even when contact is not perfect. At its core is T Squared Up Technology, featuring a CNC milled alignment channel exactly 1.68 inches wide to match the diameter of a golf ball. Paired with our MAG Technology, which uses precision milled alignment lines in the center insert, it creates a visual reference system that frames the ball, promotes a square setup, and reinforces a consistent stroke. The TS-1029’s clean alignment geometry, balanced profile, and wide range of finish options suit a variety of putting styles. Milled to exacting standards and finished in signature T Squared style, it is the modern answer for players who demand confidence, consistency, and performance in every round.
